title: FishyFoolMod
description: A mod for fishyfool modpack. Provides many features as Mojang's joke, removed, mentioned and unused.
body:
A mod for fishyfool modpack. Provides many features as Mojang's joke, removed, mentioned and unused.

You can find more info and manage the switches in config file named fishyfool.toml.

Feutures:

1. You'll get something new from fishing. Probability:

    0.5 of lily pads change to boats

    0.16 of fish change to live fish

    0.03 of cod change to squid

    0.06 of cod change to guardian

    0.01 of cod change to elder guardian


2. As in Halloween, bat can spawn at light 6 or less now!

3. As in halloween, you can find 22.5% certain mob(zombies, zombie villagers, husks, drowned, skeletons, strays, zombified piglins, and wither skeletons) wearing carved pumpkin and 2.5% of certain mob wearing  jack o'lanterns.

4. As a Mojang joke, 0.05 of little pig will spawn riding a Jockey Chicken.

5. There is a 4% probability that each rabbit will be a killer rabbit when it spawns.
